picks.reasoning: I trust the stronger players, and Smash in the bot lane is the best individual on this Summoner's Rift. DK already beat G2 2-0 this summer, and the LCK-LEC gap is real. Caps can steal a game on his own, but I'm not betting on a Caps hero play when DK have the cleaner player edge across the map. G2's comeback stories are fun, but the stronger players win the series.

Tempo decides this one, and G2 are the better early-game team: they grab first tower and set up dragons. But DK already beat them in the EWC groups, and LCK teams are the ones who actually hold a lead once they have it. Caps can swing a mid-game fight, but I want the team that controls the first fifteen minutes, and with Smash popping off bot and a Vi/Jarvan jungle pathing into side lanes, DK should get there first. The region gap tips it DK's way.

Draft is where this one gets decided, and DK already read G2's book at EWC and won it cleanly. Jayce and Gnar in the top lane, Smash on the carry picks, and a Lulu/Milio support pool give them real flexibility, while G2 lean on Caps finding Orianna or Viktor comfort. I trust the LCK drafting edge on this stage. G2 can snowball and Caps can absolutely take over, but DK have the cleaner draft plan, and I'll back that over a mid-lane hero game.

Look, G2's last 20 games are gorgeous, but the region gap is the loudest number on the board: LEC is 3-5 against the LCK this year, and DK already beat G2 2-0 at EWC. Caps can swing a game by himself, but Smash and a DK side that has handled international opponents will be the steadier hand in a single game. I'm not going higher than two-thirds, because DK's throws keep the door open for G2.

Chemistry is where I land, and DK walked out of EWC with a title and the kind of loose, confident energy that carries into a Swiss opener. They've already beaten G2 cleanly this year, and that sticks in a locker room. G2 have heart and Caps can swing any game, but the LCK edge is too big to ignore, and a team that's just lifted a trophy together is the one I trust under the lights.
